title: What a Creole Wants, What a Creole Needs

bias_targets.methodology: Surveying Creole language speakers and experts to assess the disparity between the language technologies assumed to be needed by researchers and the actual needs of the communities, alongside a systematic audit of existing Creole NLP resources.

Qualitative evaluation and community consultation regarding the irrelevance of datasets created via direct translation from high-resource languages, which often inappropriately transfer high-resource cultural and geographical concepts (e.g., American football) to low-resource communities.
